DESIGN PROPOSAL — developed design, buildable; confirm by survey &
1.0 EPDM liner on 300 g underlay, black
200 RC wall C35/45 XC4, Ø10 @ 200 EF
Alu rails 40 + 10 air gap, SS anchors
80 permeable concrete pavers, 8 mm joints with 2–6 grit
• Pool: 600 x 3600, water depth 530; submersible pump 3 m³/h + 9 W UV clarifier + skimmer box; weir blade at
N end; overflow at +0.40 to soakaway; mains top-up via float valve + RPZ backflow.
• Rain chains: 2 no. copper; W into pool, E into gravel basin → RWH tank.
• RWH tank 2000 L flat underground, inlet filter, calmed inlet, 0.5 kW pump, controller; feeds living wall,
planter drip & pool top-up; overflow to SA1 soakaway.
• FLL / GRO code; sedum mix ≥ 8 species; 300 gravel margins & around outlets; inspection 2x/yr.
• Saturated load 1.30 kN/m² → joists C200 @ 450, beams as A + front beam RHS 200x100 on 3 CHS posts.
• Ledger to façade as Design A (survey). Posts CHS 139.7x6.3 on 250 base plates, pads 600x600x700.
• ULS ≈ 4.1 kN/m²: front beam spans 2.0 m — trivial; joists 3.3 m @ 450 M ≈ 2.5 kNm.
